channel.title: The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from all 55 African countries, every source cited.

item.title: Sierra Leone advances open contracting in Africa
item.description: The nation showcased progress in transparent public procurement at a Rabat conference, aiming to reduce corruption.

item.description: No vice president in Sierra Leone has ever been elected president, raising questions about the current officeholder's future.
